sprite_families.name: Water
sprite_families.description: Replenish shields while standing in water! Increases in power at each Level Up: 2 Shield -> 3 Shield -> 4 Shield -> 5 Shield -> 6 Shield per tick

sprite_families.name: Earth
sprite_families.description: You have a chance to find additional rare items when opening chests. Chance increases at each Level Up: 10% -> 12.5% -> 15% -> 17.5% -> 20% chance to find additional rare loot

sprite_families.name: Fire
sprite_families.description: Creates a fiery burst when you deal enough damage to an enemy! Required damage decreases at each Level Up: 150 Damage -> 125 Damage -> 100 Damage -> 75 Damage -> 50 Damage to trigger

sprite_families.name: Duck
sprite_families.description: Emoting or Jamming replenishes shields. Increases in power at each Level Up: 2 Shield -> 3 Shield -> 4 Shield -> 6 Shield -> 8 Shield per tick

sprite_families.name: Ghost
sprite_families.description: Grants cloak for a duration upon reloading. Increases in duration at each Level Up: 3 Seconds -> 3.5 Seconds -> 4 Seconds -> 4.5 Seconds -> 5 Seconds

sprite_families.name: Dream
sprite_families.description: Grants a random item at each level, exploding with legendary loot at Max Level. Loot value increases at each Level Up!

sprite_families.name: Punk
sprite_families.description: Possibly nothing... or infinitely something

sprite_families.name: King
sprite_families.description: Your Pickaxe deals more damage. Increases in damage at each Level Up: 30 -> 40 -> 60 -> 80 -> 120 bonus damage

sprite_families.name: Zero Point
sprite_families.description: Spawn a Shield Bubble Jr. when you use a healing item on yourself (excluding splashes and grenades). Increases in duration at each Level Up: 6 Seconds -> 7 Seconds -> 8 Seconds -> 9 Seconds -> 10 Seconds

sprite_families.name: Demon
sprite_families.description: Siphon some health and shields when you eliminate an opponent. Increases in power at each Level Up: 10 Healing -> 15 Healing -> 20 Healing -> 25 Healing -> 30 Healing per elimination

sprite_families.name: Burnt Peanut
sprite_families.description: Goop! When eliminating players, you may find more loot. Sometimes mythic! Chance increases at each Level Up: 20% -> 30% -> 40% -> 50% -> 60% chance to find more loot. 10% chance to find Mythic at Max Level!

sprite_families.name: Boss
sprite_families.description: Grants an increase to your max HP and Shield. Increases at each Level Up: 5 HP/Shield -> 10 HP/Shield -> 15 HP/Shield -> 20 HP/Shield -> 25 HP/Shield

sprite_families.name: Seven
sprite_families.description: Enemy player foot trails are visible in the world for your Squad. Duration increases at each Level Up: 10 Seconds -> 15 Seconds -> 20 Seconds -> 25 Seconds -> 30 Second foot trails

sprite_families.name: Fishy
sprite_families.description: Swim speed greatly increased. Taking damage also briefly increases movement speed. Increases in power at each Level Up: 25% Swim Speed / 10% Movement Speed -> 50% Swim Speed / 20% Movement Speed -> 100% Swim Speed / 30% Movement Speed -> 150% Swim Speed / 40% Movement Speed -> 200% Swim Speed / 50% Movement Speed Bonuses

sprite_families.name: Striker
sprite_families.description: Gain the Overdrive effect when you Mantle, Hurdle, or Wall Scramble. Duration increases at each Level Up: 6 Seconds -> 7 Seconds -> 8 Seconds -> 9 Seconds -> 10 Seconds of Overdrive

sprite_families.name: Aura
sprite_families.description: Gain a Shock Rock charge when you deal enough damage to enemies! Required damage decreases at each Level Up: 175 Damage -> 150 Damage -> 125 Damage -> 100 Damage -> 75 Damage to trigger

sprite_families.name: Air
sprite_families.description: Increases sprinting speed and jump height. Also nullifies fall damage. Jump height increased with each Level Up!

sprite_families.name: Grim
sprite_families.description: Players who attack you are marked for a duration. Increases in duration at each Level Up: 3 Seconds -> 3.5 Seconds -> 4 Seconds -> 4.5 Seconds -> 5 Seconds

sprite_families.name: Overshield
sprite_families.description: Grants overshield, scaling with level.

sprite_families.name: Mega Man
sprite_families.description: Slip and slide around with reduced friction while Sliding. Slide farther with each Level Up!

sprite_families.name: X-Ray
sprite_families.description: Periodically mark enemies in an area around you. Mark more often with each Level Up!

sprite_families.name: Onigiri
sprite_families.description: Applies Overdrive after eating or drinking a Consumable. Overdrive lasts longer with each Level Up!

sprite_families.name: Blinky
sprite_families.description: Grants cloak for a duration when you take damage. Cloak duration increases with each Level Up!

sprite_families.name: Birthday
sprite_families.description: Opening chests has a chance to spawn a piece of cake. Eliminations can spawn cake at max level. Chance to spawn cake increases with each Level Up!

sprite_families.name: Crash Bandicoot
sprite_families.description: (Active - Jump In Air) Triggers a whirlwind attack, damaging and knocking back nearby enemies. Damage increases and cooldown decreases with each Level Up!

sprite_families.name: John Wick
sprite_families.description: Knocking players reveals others nearby. Mark duration increases at each Level Up: 3 Seconds -> 3.5 Seconds -> 4 Seconds -> 4.5 Seconds -> 5 Seconds

sprite_families.name: Batman
sprite_families.description: Grants the ability to launch in the air and deploy the Bat Cape!

sprite_families.name: Pond
sprite_families.description: (Active) - Jump shortly after landing to trigger a Super Jump, if charges are present. Gain charges over time. Super jump strength increases and cooldown decreases with each Level Up!

sprite_families.name: Pollo
sprite_families.description: Upon earning an elimination, slowly replenish shield for you and nearby squad members for a duration. Duration increases at each Level Up: 6 Seconds -> 7 Seconds -> 8 Seconds -> 9 Seconds -> 10 Seconds

sprite_families.name: Vini Jr.
sprite_families.description: Sprinting for a short time makes your slide destructive. Slidekicking enemies increases rate of fire and reload speed. Increases in power at each Level Up: 40 dmg / 10% fire rate -> 45 dmg / 20% fire rate -> 50 dmg / 30% fire rate -> 55 dmg / 40% fire rate -> 60 dmg / 50% fire rate

sprite_families.name: Ironmouse
sprite_families.description: Regenerate health over time when low. While regenerating, gain Cloak and low gravity! Health regenerated to increases at each Level Up: 60 Health -> 70 Health -> 80 Health -> 90 Health -> 100 Health

sprite_families.name: Llama
sprite_families.description: Opening ammo boxes has a chance to grant a weapon upgrade. Chance increases at each Level Up: 5% -> 10% -> 15% -> 17% -> 20%

sprite_families.name: Peeky Peely
sprite_families.description: Emits a ping for players with rare sprites nearby, but marks you on the map. Ping radius increases at each Level Up: 40m -> 50m -> 60m -> 70m -> 80m

sprite_families.name: Jackrabbit
sprite_families.description: (Active - Jump In Air) Double Jump. Cooldown between jumps decreases with each Level Up!

sprite_families.name: Shadow
sprite_families.description: Automatically reload unequipped weapons over time. Reloads equipped weapon at max level. Automatic reload gets faster with each Level Up!

sprite_families.name: Bush
sprite_families.description: Grants a bush on you after a duration, gain a bush on elimination at max level. Time between bush activating decreases with each Level Up!

sprite_families.name: Tails
sprite_families.description: (Active - Jump In Air) Hover with the help of Tails! Hover speed increased with each Level Up!

sprite_families.name: Killswitch
sprite_families.description: (Active - Aim In Air) Enter Hangtime with improved accuracy. Accuracy increases with each Level Up!

sprite_families.name: Adventure
sprite_families.description: Upgrades a random item in the player's inventory with each Level Up!

sprite_families.name: Klombo
sprite_families.description: Grants random items at each level, only levels up by consuming items. Item quality increases with each Level Up!

sprite_families.name: Jonesy
sprite_families.description: Recover some health or shields after being damaged after a short duration. Increase amount healed with each Level Up!

sprite_families.name: Sonic
sprite_families.description: Gotta Go Fast! Sprint faster with each Level Up!

sprite_families.name: Crown
sprite_families.description: Only levels up by winning matches while equipped. Mastery with 1 win. New variants unlocked after mastering!

sprite_families.name: 8-Bit
sprite_families.description: Find an 8-Bit Shotgun in your first chest and gain a score multiplier for it.

sprite_families.name: Storm Scout
sprite_families.description: Applies Overdrive after taking a certain amount of storm damage. Reveals future Storm Circles at max level. Increases Overdrive duration with each Level Up!

sprite_families.name: Morgana
sprite_families.description: Increases the effectiveness of healing items. Healing effectiveness increases with each Level Up!

sprite_families.name: Spooky Dash
sprite_families.description: (Active - Jump In Air) Spooky Dash lets you phase through some objects. Gain charges over time. Charge cooldown decreases with each Level Up!

sprite_families.name: Vampire
sprite_families.description: Recover health when damaging an enemy. Health recovered percent increases with each Level Up!

sprite_families.name: The Deer
sprite_families.description: Melee attacks deal more damage. Melee attack damage increases with each Level Up!

sprite_families.name: Dumpster Dive
sprite_families.description: Food provides bonus healing. Find food when jumping out of hiding props, and a small chance when opening containers. Find better food with each Level Up!

variants.name: Cheatmaster
variants.effect: Button mash! All inputs are correct when entering cheat codes found in the world

variants.name: Hacker
variants.effect: Increases chances of spawning items from your Loot Hacks.

variants.name: Reaper
variants.effect: Chance to find sprites when eliminating opponents. Only gains sprite XP from eliminations, unless sprite has special XP rules.

variants.name: Candy
variants.effect: Gain 20% more Sprite Dust upon Extraction

variants.name: Galaxy
variants.effect: Gain 30% more Ammo whenever picked up in the world

variants.name: Holofoil
variants.effect: 5% chance for your squad to find rare Sprite Variants from looting chests
